_comment: Route B (decision-graph) vocabulary. Extends taxonomy.json — the step vocab (actions/objects/systems) is reused from there; this file adds the three axes a flowchart needs: the presenting problem (trigger), the condition that gates a branch (guard), and the terminal state (outcome). Each is coerced to these values during validation; unknown -> 'other' (guard -> null when none stated). Free-text intent/guard_detail/outcome_intent live alongside the coded values in the extracted record, not here.

triggers.password_forgotten: User forgot a password or it expired
triggers.account_locked: Account locked out / too many bad sign-ins
triggers.login_failure: Cannot sign in for a reason other than a plain lockout
triggers.mfa_issue: MFA lost, new device, or not prompting
triggers.access_request: Request for access/permission to a resource
triggers.new_hire_onboarding: Provision a new starter (accounts, mailbox, licence)
triggers.license_request: Assign, change, or remove a licence
triggers.mailbox_access_request: Access to a shared or another user's mailbox
triggers.group_membership_change: Add/remove a user from a group or distribution list
triggers.policy_change_request: Change a conditional-access / security / config policy
triggers.device_lifecycle_request: Enrol, wipe, or retire a managed device
triggers.profile_update_request: Change a user attribute or profile field
triggers.other: A real trigger that fits nothing above

guards.self_service_failed: Self-service / portal path did not work, needed manual action
guards.hybrid_account: Account is synced/hybrid, so the change was needed in more than one directory
guards.still_failing: The attempted fix did not resolve it; issue persisted
guards.resolved_after_action: The action worked and the issue was resolved
guards.no_customer_reply: Waiting on the customer / no response
guards.awaiting_approval: Blocked pending manager or change approval
guards.missing_info: Request lacked required detail; had to go back for it
guards.requires_escalation: Beyond first-line; handed to another team or vendor
guards.account_not_found: The target account/object did not exist
guards.other: A real branch condition that fits nothing above

outcomes.resolved_first_contact: Resolved in a single touch, no follow-up
outcomes.resolved_after_followup: Resolved, but only after further contact / a second session
outcomes.reopened: Reopened or re-raised under another workflow after a failed fix
outcomes.escalated_internal: Handed off to a colleague/team and left there
outcomes.escalated_vendor: Raised with a supplier/third party and left there
outcomes.resolved_unspecified: Notes say resolved but give no detail of what was done
outcomes.no_action: Closed with no technical work (duplicate, out of scope, self-resolved)
outcomes.other: A real terminal state that fits nothing above
